question: Where and when sacrifice the thin one?
premises: abandoning here — success in good middle, in vessel
in the middle sacrifice the thin
this day-and-night sacrifice performing, and others by day
inference: Thin oblation in the good-middle vessel, day-and-night performed.
plain_english: Abandoning here — success in good middle, in the vessel in the middle sacrifice the thin — this day-and-night sacrifice performing, and others by day.
